title: Remove the Microsoft News app (Store package Microsoft.BingNews)
description: Removes the Microsoft News Store package (Microsoft.BingNews) for the current user. The package is reinstallable from the Microsoft Store. On undo the package is re-registered from its install location when the files are still on disk; if they are gone, the undo result carries the documented winget identifier and the post-undo verification reports honestly that restoration was not possible.
